notes: Captured from real rmcp router, not inferred from pinned SednaLabs schema. This is a native input-schema snapshot, not live Google or complete upstream parameter parity. Extended table describe/summarize controls are source-reviewed and require feature-CI schema equality; source_commit is the original capture provenance, not an assertion that all later fields came from that historical SHA. The local diagnostic release/landing tools additionally advertise bounded max_rows/max_cell_chars; the historical source commit in this file refers to the original capture only, not later CI-updated additions. Ingestion input controls are now explicitly accepted, validated and, when unsupported or incomplete, rejected or marked partial before upstream operations. Full SednaLabs multi-page and output behavior are not yet achieved and live testing is open. Historical/realtime optional ingest limit input now uses the pinned u64 width; bounded actual ingest still rejects values exceeding 1,000 before any outbound request. Pivot keep_empty_rows now uses a nonnullable bool with default false, matching the pinned upstream tool schema; the original source_commit remains original historical capture provenance. The six scratchpad output_mode fields now reuse the same strongly typed four-option nullable enum as run_report; the historic source commit records original capture, not later reviewed schema updates.
